principle_1_brain_above_runtime.evidence: All 10 components defined as additive layers. 7 hook points specified as pre/post-processing. Contract §forbidden_actions explicitly prohibits runtime modification.

principle_2_memory_foundation.evidence: MemoryBrain is foundation component. All 9 other components read/write through MemoryBrain. Separate brain_state.db for brain-specific state, memory.py for canonical memories.

principle_3_evidence_backed.evidence: Every component interface includes evidence references. DecisionMemory links to evidence. ExperienceMemory extracts from evaluation evidence. Evolution requires evidence for capability proposals.

principle_4_personal_sovereign.evidence: Personal Preference Model models ONE owner. No multi-tenant design. Identity contract PROHIBIT-03 enforced: no multi-user model.

principle_5_incremental_activation.evidence: 5 activation phases: Foundation → Knowledge → Cognition → Meta → Evolution. Each phase depends on sufficient memory foundation from prior phases.

component_interaction_audit.evidence: Interaction matrix defined in contract §component_interaction_matrix. MemoryBrain is the hub — 9 bidirectional or write relationships. ReasoningKernel is read-only consumer. Evolution is write-only producer.

p1_new.title: Brain state isolation — separate DB required
p1_new.description: Brain state must live in .nexara/brain_state.db, completely separate from runtime .nexara/store.db. Accidental cross-contamination would violate component isolation.
p1_new.mitigation: Contract §data_architecture explicitly mandates separate database. Implementation must enforce with connection-level isolation.

p2_new.title: ReasoningKernel latency — must not block runtime pipeline
p2_new.description: ReasoningKernel sits between context assembly and execution. If reasoning is slow, it could delay mission execution. Needs timeout + fallback to direct execution.
p2_new.mitigation: Implementation must include configurable reasoning timeout with graceful degradation to non-enriched execution.

p2_new.title: Knowledge Graph scalability — entity explosion risk
p2_new.description: Entity extraction from all semantic memories could produce unbounded entity counts. Needs rate limiting and pruning.
p2_new.mitigation: Contract includes graph pruning and confidence-based decay. Implementation must enforce entity budget.

p2_new.title: Evolution governance — human approval implementation
p2_new.description: Evolution Mechanism proposes new capabilities. The human approval gate is specified but the approval UX is not designed.
p2_new.mitigation: Requires separate UX contract for evolution approval flow before Phase 5 activation.
